extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users (Signing Officials, Program Directors/Principal Investigators, TTO Administrators, delegates/assistants)
extracted.subtask_short: eRA Commons status and profile operations
extracted.subtask_description: Operational guidance for managing Institution and Personal Profiles and for using the Status module in eRA Commons (searching grants, JIT, RPPR, closeout, inclusion, eSubmission tracking), including role-based permissions and required data fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: View Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component
rubrics_metrics.description: The information displays as read-only: Address; Contact Name; Phone; Email; Are batch uploads allowed by this organization?; The month that begins the utilization period; Are the inventions submitted by the organization assigned for administration and reporting by the user?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accessed by clicking the component tile header and selecting the View button from the Extramural Technology Transfer Administrations component tile header. Display is read-only unless editing privileges apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component
rubrics_metrics.description: If you hold the TTO_Admin or SO role within an organization, you can edit the fields in the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component of the Institution Profile. The following fields are available for editing: Street Address; City; Country; State/Province; Zip/Postal Code; Contact Name; Phone; Email; Are batch uploads allowed by this organization?; The month that begins the utilization period; Are the inventions submitted by the organization assigned for administration and reporting by the user?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the Edit button on the Extramural Technology Transfer Administrations tile header to display editable fields. For boolean fields select a value from the drop-down list (Yes/No). IMPORTANT: Only Commons users with the SO role can edit the Institution Profile. Exception: institutions with a TTO Administrator and no Signing Official — the TTO Administrator can edit all sections. For institutions with both a Signing Official and TTO Administrator, the TTO Administrator can only edit the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Assurances and Certifications component (contents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains data elements that compose assurance/certification information about an institution (e.g., Human Subjects Assurance Number, Institutional Review Board [IRB] Approval Date, IRB Type, Animal Welfare Assurance Number, and Institutional Animal Care & Use Committee [IACUC] Unacknowledged Certification Explanation). Provides a means of viewing and managing the checklist of these assurances and certifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The screen is viewable via the Assurances & Certifications link on the dashboard or the Assurances and Certifications tab. For most users information is read-only; SO role can edit. The list is viewable by anyone with access to the Institution Profile. Read-only check marks display next to each assurance/certification with the date the institution indicated compliance. Policy note: not all assurances/certifications may apply to every institution — refer to Part III of the SF424 (R&R) Application Guide for definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status displayed for Institutional Assurances and Certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status section displays the Office of Research and Integrity Certification Status for the institution. The values for this field are either 'Assurance OK' or 'Expired'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An expired status displays in red text as a warning. The expiration date displays below the status and appears in red text if already expired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing Assurances and Certifications (permission & actions)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you hold the SO role within an organization, you can edit the assurance and certification indicators in the Institution Profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the Edit Assurances and Certifications button to edit indicators. Indicators display over several categories; check or uncheck as appropriate. Use the '(explain your answer)' link to provide additional information in a text box. When done select Save All or Discard Changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances & Certifications - Discrimination compliance items
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with all laws, policies and regulations prohibiting discrimination based on: Age Discrimination Assurance; Civil Rights Assurance; Handicapped Individuals Assurance; Inclusion of Children Policy; Sex Discrimination Assurance; Women and Minority Inclusion Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check/uncheck the appropriate certification/assurance indicators when editing. Use the explain link for additional details if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances & Certifications - Laws and regulations items
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with all laws and regulations regarding: ClinicalTrials.gov Requirement; Conflict of Interest Assurance; Delinquent Debt Assurance; Drugfree Workplace Assurance; Impact of Grant Activities on the Environment and Historic Properties; Institutional Debarment Assurance; Lobbying Assurance; Smoke-Free Workplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These indicators are toggled in the Assurances and Certifications editing screen; consult SF424 (R&R) Part III for full definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances & Certifications - Research requirements items
rubrics_metrics.description: Research at this institution meets all requirements for: Graduate Student Training for Doctoral Degrees (D43, TU2, T15, T32, T37, T90, U2R, U90, and U54/TL1 only); Human Subjects; PI Assurance; Prohibited Research; Recombinant DNA and Human Gene Transfer; Research Misconduct; Research With Human Embryonic Stem Cells; Select Agent Research; Transplantation of Human Fetal Tissue; Vertebrate Animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select/check appropriate items when editing. Use the explanatory text box for any unacknowledged certification explanations. Refer to SF424 (R&R) guidance for applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Profile module - purpose and sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Personal Profile module is the central repository of information for all Commons registered users and is designed so individual eRA users maintain accuracy of their profile information. Profile sections include Name and ID; Demographics; Employment; Reviewer Information; Trainee Information; Education; Reference Letters; Publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Profile information is integrated across eRA systems for business such as peer review, application data, and trainee data. You can delegate authority to maintain your profile to other users within your institution. Access to sections depends on Commons role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status module - overall purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status screens allow PD/PIs, their delegates, and SOs to: track the status of grant applications through submission; view applications, Notices of Award (NoAs), and other key documents; and complete several post-submission and post-award transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: What you can see and do depends on the role associated with your Commons account. Use the module-specific help topics for SO and PI users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status module - available query types
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status module provides the following types of queries: General Search; Just in Time; Pending Progress Reports; Recently Awarded; Recent/Pending eSubmissions; Closeout; Change of Institution; Pending Inclusion Action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All queries are performed by entering parameters on the appropriate search screen and selecting the Search button. Select the links on the main Status screen to access each query type.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Search query parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter one or more of: Grant Number; Accession Number; Grants.gov Tracking #; PI Name; Application Status; Eligible for FFATA Reporting (checkbox); Eligible for Hurricane Sandy Reporting (checkbox); Budget Start Date and Budget End Date; Organization Hierarchy (School, Division, Department).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accession Number: unique value assigned by CSR to applications before being assigned an NIH grant number. Dates may be entered manually (MM/DD/YYYY) or selected from a calendar. Results provide links for grant-specific functionality (e.g., RPPR, JIT, No-Cost Extensions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Just In Time (JIT) eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Commons provides the JIT link for applications receiving a percentile of less than 30 or for applications receiving a priority score of between 100 and 300 if no percentile is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SOs can search for JIT-eligible applications using Grant Number, PI Name, Application Status, and Organization Hierarchy parameters. From results select the JIT link in the Action column to open the Just In Time screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Progress Report search parameters and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Query parameters: Grant Number; Late Progress Report (checkbox); Due Date (From/To range); PI Name; Application Status; Organization Hierarchy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From results select the RPPR link to access RPPR Menu for editing/submitting Research Performance Progress Reports. Select the Closed link to access Closeout Status for submitting a Final Progress Report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently Awarded search parameters
rubrics_metrics.description: Query parameters: Grant Number; PI Name; Organization Hierarchy; Days Since Award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results include the same action links as General Search (RPPR, JIT, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent/Pending eSubmissions search parameters and eSubmission actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Query parameters: Accession Number; Grants.gov Tracking #; eSubmission Status; Received Date (From/To range).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results include Show All Prior Errors link (opens Errors/Warnings for Prior Failed eSubmissions), Application ID link (opens Status Information showing any eSubmission errors/warnings), and Reject eApplication action (available to SO users to reject an eSubmission).

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout search parameters and checkboxes
rubrics_metrics.description: Query parameters: Grant Number; PI Name; Project End Date (From/To range); Closeout Status; Organization Hierarchy; Requires FFR/FSR (checkbox); Requires Final Progress Report (checkbox); Requires Final Invention Statement (checkbox); Requires FRAM (checkbox).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From results select the Requires Closeout link to access the Closeout Status screen for uploading required closeout documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Institution search and relinquishing statements
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can search applications with relinquishing statements using: Grant Number (Institution Code and Serial Number are required) and PI Name. To search for Relinquishing Statements use Grant Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From results select the Managing Relinquishing Statement link to access the Managing Relinquishing Statement screen. Refer to Change of Institution online help for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pending Inclusion Action behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can retrieve grants having Inclusion Data Records (IDRs) requiring updates or another action. Statuses included are Grantee Updates in Progress or Pending SO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view/manage IDRs select the Inclusion link from results which takes you to the Inclusion Management System (IMS). IMPORTANT: To submit inclusion enrollment data with a progress report, IMS must be accessed via RPPR Section G rather than through the Inclusion link in the Status module. Refer to the RPPR Instruction Guide for more info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Result - General Search display and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status Result screen provides matching records in tables and includes links to other Commons modules/features. The screen has a limit of 100 records per view with additional records accessed via page links/navigation arrows. Columns may be sortable if an up/down arrow is present in the column heading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sort by clicking the arrow in column headers where available. The sample action links shown may vary by application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields displayed in Status results and meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: Results include: Application ID (link to Status Information; MPI indicator if multiple PIs); Grants.gov Tracking # (non-sortable); Proposal Title; PD/PI Name; Application Status (values include Awarded, Pending, Withdrawn, Terminated, Not Funded, Returned, Received, eSubmission Error); Budget Start Date; FFATA indicator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting Application ID opens Status Information with status history, study section, contacts, etc. FFATA column shows Yes if eligible for Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act reporting. Show All Prior Errors link shows eSubmission error history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action links in Status results and role restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Possible links: RPPR; Public Access PRAM; IC Requested PRAM; Fellowship Face Page; Progress Report Face Page; JIT; Extension (No-Cost Extension); Closed; Requires Closeout; Reject eApplication; Transmittal Sheet; Administrative Supplement; Manage Relinquishing Statement; Relinquishing Statement; Sandy Quarterly Report; Inclusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each link opens the corresponding module/screen (e.g., RPPR opens RPPR Menu). 'Reject eApplication' is available only to SO users and sets status to Refused. Some face pages depend on grant type (e.g., Fellowship Face Page displays for Fellowship Awards only).

rubrics_metrics.name: PI landing options and delegation
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon entering Status, a PI is taken to a landing page with three options: Recent/Pending eSubmissions; List of Applications/Grants; Grants.gov Tracking Number search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A PI may grant an ASST role to another Commons user to view Status as the PI would; ASST users cannot access the links found in the Action column (i.e., they can view but not perform actions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent/Pending eSubmissions result columns for PI
rubrics_metrics.description: Table includes Grants.gov Tracking #; Application ID (link to Status Information; MPI indicator if multiple PIs); eSubmission Status; Proposal Title; PD/PI Name; eSubmission Status Date; Show All Prior Errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the number of records exceeds the screen limit use page links/navigation arrows. Columns are sortable if arrow present. Show All Prior Errors opens Errors/Warnings for Prior Failed eSubmissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of Applications/Grants result contents for PI
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides basic information for a PI's grants: Application ID; Grants.gov Tracking #; Proposal Title; PD/PI Name; eSubmission Status; Current Application Status; Action links (same possible links as for SO results).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this screen to view assignments, summary statements, notices of award, and to access other Commons modules (e.g., RPPR, Inclusion). Inclusion access note: to submit inclusion enrollment with a progress report use RPPR Section G.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by Grants.gov Tracking Number
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the Grants.gov tracking number into the Grants.gov Tracking Number field and select Search; Status returns only the application matching the entered tracking number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To return to the search screen select the Search by Grants.gov Tracking Num tab on the navigation menu.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Information screen contents and eSubmission warnings
rubrics_metrics.description: Status Information is a collection of grant information and links; unresolved errors or warnings display at the top of the screen. The General Grant Information section includes: Status; Institution Name; School Name; School Category; Division Name; Department Name; PI Name; Application ID; Proposal Title; Proposal Receipt Date; Last Status Update Date; Current Award Notice Date; Application Source; Project Period Begin Date; Project Period End Date; eApplication Status; FOA; NIH Appl ID.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select Application Number from any result screen to open Status Information. If unresolved eSubmission errors/warnings exist they are shown clearly at the top. 'Other Relevant Documents' section includes links to grant-related documents.
